about: Tutorial 1 recordings: the Google Drive ZIPs of 2026-10-11/12 and the loose takes, archived untouched in artifacts/tutorial-voice/raw/<zip or loose-date>/. One row per raw take: its character, the recording key it serves (null: no place yet). status: mapped; inferred (the key is reasoned, see note); intended (its words differ from older script history but are the intended script wording, per the creator); alternate (a second take of a key, mastered, not played); dropped (set aside by the creator: not processed, the raw take kept); duplicate (the same file supplied again: sameAs names the row used); unplaced (no beat yet); staged (recorded for a line the script has not placed yet: mastered for review, not served); general (Spellblade VO outside the tutorial). Captions come from the script; words is given where the plan does not have them yet. chain: this take's exceptions to its character's preset (a preset of its own, pitchEngine, gainDb), with why. repairs: its own fixes, with why (tools/audio/tutorial_voice.py: excise, splice, mend, release). Character presets: tools/audio/tutorial-voice-chains.json.

takes.speaker: narrator
takes.note: Replaces "No. Truly look around." The intended script wording (creator, 2026-10-12); the script is being updated to match.

repairs.why: The voice breaks in the middle of the "Ah...": a creak, then an aperiodic break with a 40 ms flip up an octave (about 330 Hz, 0.74-0.79 s), steady voice again from 0.83 s; every pitch change turned the flip into a stray note (creator, 2026-10-12). The break is cut out and the voice joined cycle to cycle either side of it: only the performance, nothing made or repeated; the take is 0.16 s shorter. Two earlier repairs were heard as glitches: a WORLD mend (a machine-steady vowel) and a splice (the take's own cycles played back and forth to fill the gap, a stutter) (creator, 2026-10-12/13).
